title: Finite ε-net of n-planes in projection operator norm (Simon Ch. 3, proof of 1.6, choice of π₁,…,π_N)
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ and ε > 0 there are N ∈ ℕ and n-dimensional linear subspaces T₁,…,T_N of ℝ^P such that every n-dimensional linear subspace Q of ℝ^P satisfies ‖p_Q − p_{T_j}‖ < ε for some j, where p_V is the orthogonal projection onto V and ‖·‖ the operator norm.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ (N : ℕ) (T : Fin N → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), (∀ j, Module.finrank ℝ (T j) = n) ∧ ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = n → ∃ j, ‖Q.starProjection - (T j).starProjection‖ < ε
